title: Owlshift install manifest
description:
What Owlshift wrote outside its data directory: the service installed at
login and the keychain entries `owlshift init` stored. `owlshift
uninstall` removes exactly what it lists, then the manifest.

format.description: The format version of this document.

service.description: The service installed at login, while it is.

InstalledService.description: The service installed at login: its files, each an absolute path.

launcher.description: The `/bin/sh` launcher the unit runs, beside it.

link.description:
The link that enables a systemd unit at login, which `systemctl
enable` makes.

unit.description: The unit: the LaunchAgent's property list, or the systemd unit file.

KeychainEntry.description: A keychain entry: the service it is filed under and its account.

ServiceManager.description: The service manager a service is installed with.

oneOf.description: A systemd user unit, on Linux and WSL2.
